digest.component_or_area: plan-review reviewer prompts and criteria routing
propositions: Dual vocabulary 'success criteria' and 'acceptance criteria' in reviewer prompts is pooled into a single bar by the model, creating false semantic distinction where none exists in implementation

Textual substitution must rename 'Success Criteria' to 'Acceptance Criteria' in specified reviewer prompt files and the criteria routing index while preserving generic English usage in plan_review_T2.md and definition-of-done wording in verifier prompts
The generated criteria-guide document must be regenerated from the updated prompts and routing index to remove downstream SC vocabulary occurrences while maintaining its GENERATED banner

Editing criteria_routing.json rotates the regver stamp, invalidating outstanding plan-review attestations, but this is safe only after ticket 1f32-f86e-8a51-4d8e (ADR 0053) grandfathers the regver rotation at the claim gate
